text:
maria: FYI getting reports users flipping between admin and viewer after SSO login this morning. Seen on 3 tenants so far, small sample but reproducible.

sam: Any recent RBAC or role-mapper changes? I didn't push anything during the window.

anj: I rolled the role-mapper refactor (service/role-mapper v0.7.2) last night. I added stricter validation for SAML attrs (department / affiliation) to tighten JIT provisioning rules. Thought it was safe.

leo: Can you share repro steps?

maria: Repro by logging in via Okta -> SAML SP. For affected users the SAML assertion is missing eduPersonScopedAffiliation and department, so mapper returns an empty roles array and our fallback path assigns org-default. Logs show: 

```
level=warn service=role-mapper event=map_roles user_id=U12345 tenant=T42 roles=[] fallback=org-default
level=error service=auth signature_verification=failed err="kms:Decrypt timeout"
```

deploy-bot: rolled out service/role-mapper v0.7.2 to prod (canary) at 2026-03-20T02:15Z.

alex: That fallback to org-default should never grant admin-level perms. Historically the default was org-viewer. Did the refactor change the default mapping?

anj: Reviewing the change now — I suspect a conditional got inverted when I normalized empty attributes into null vs []. If roles==null we ended up taking the admin-default branch. I can roll back the canary.

sam: Also seeing KMS latency spikes around the same time in audit: ```kms_request_latency_ms p95=4200```. If SAML signature verification timed out we might be treating the assertion as unverifiable and hitting a permissive path. That's a security issue.

leo: Can we get the original SAML assertion for one repro user? The assertion shows no affiliation and our mapper should treat that as "no roles" and deny, not escalate. Example snippet from Okta assertion we grabbed: 

```
<saml:AttributeStatement>
  <saml:Attribute Name="email">alice@example.com</saml:Attribute>
  <!-- eduPersonScopedAffiliation missing for this user -->
  <saml:Attribute Name="department"></saml:Attribute>
</saml:AttributeStatement>
```

maria: Confirmed. Also audit logs show role assigned at the Auth pipeline boundary with note "fallback applied".

anj: Hotfix plan: 1) rollback canary to v0.7.1 immediately, 2) change fallback logic to be deny-by-default (no role) not org-admin, 3) add strict logging when signature verification fails and avoid JIT provisioning on unverifiable assertions. I'll push patch in the next 10m.

alex: Please open an incident and tag legal/compliance and account-safety. We need to notify affected tenants and run a backfill to revoke any improperly granted privileges.

maria: Opening incident: INC-2026-2145 and starting a blameless triage. Also request KMS key access review — the KMS key used for SAML signing (kms-key-id: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/saml/cryptoKeys/sp-sign) had a rotation on 2026-03-15. Could be related.

security-bot: New incident INC-2026-2145 created by maria. Assigned: anj (primary), alex (audit), sam (query), leo (mitigation).

sam: Running quick query to list users with role flip to org-admin between 2145000000 and 2145007000. Will post results in thread.

deploy-bot: canary rollback triggered for service/role-mapper -> v0.7.1 (status: in-progress).

anj: Rollback complete. Patching fallback behavior now and adding unit tests for empty/NULL role arrays + KMS timeout path. Will open PR (https://github.com/redwood/role-mapper/pull/981).

alex: I'll take audit/backfill. Plan: 1) find all auth events with fallback=org-default and elevated perms, 2) revoke admin tokens and notify customers, 3) create a data export for compliance.

maria: Also recommend a short-term mitigation: add admission-level validation in the SAML proxy to reject assertions missing critical attributes OR treat unverifiable assertions as failures (reject login) until KMS SLAs stabilized.

leo: Filing ticket for admission validation: TICKET-SEC-1284. Adding test harness for malformed assertions so they never reach mapping layer.

sam: Query result snippet: 
```
SELECT user_id, tenant, event_ts FROM auth_events WHERE fallback='org-default' AND event_ts BETWEEN 2145000000 AND 2145007000 LIMIT 50;
-- returns 18 rows (10 unique users across 3 tenants)
```

maria: Action items recap (assign):
- anj: patch fallback -> deny, tests, PR -> owner
- alex: audit + backfill + customer notifications -> owner
- sam: run full query and produce CSV -> owner
- leo: admission proxy validation ticket + tests -> owner
- security: coordinate incident/postmortem + compliance notification -> owner (maria)

anj: Patch merged and rolled to prod canary. Adding feature-flag to restrict aggressive JIT until postmortem.

maria: Thanks all. After incident wrap we'll review KMS rotations and put a stiffer timeout/alert on signature verification failures. :white_check_mark: 

alex: I'll start drafting customer notification templates and the audit export now.

security-bot: Incident INC-2026-2145 status updated -> Mitigated. Postmortem requested.

maria: I'll run the postmortem and include timeline + remediation. Closing thread when follow-ups are ticketed.
